landing.aboutTitle: Bridging the Gap Between Agronomy and Artificial Intelligence
landing.aboutDesc1: KrishiMitra was built from the ground up for Indian agricultural realities. By pairing computer vision with hyper-local weather indices and agricultural economics, we place research-grade intelligence in every farmer's hands.
landing.aboutDesc2: Whether monitoring crop health in Marathwada or checking market trends across Maharashtra mandis, KrishiMitra empowers growers with proactive decision-making.
landing.pillar1Desc: Deep convolutional vision neural networks identifying 38 crop leaf pathogens and pests with over 94% accuracy.
landing.pillar2Desc: Weather telemetry paired with soil test parameters for calibrated micro-irrigation and spraying windows.
landing.pillar3Desc: Real-time mandi auction price modeling and neural price trend projections with MSP guardrails.
landing.pillar4Desc: Instant voice-ready guidance in Marathi, Hindi, and English with offline-resilient assistance.
landing.growersHeroDesc: Real-time leaf pathology diagnostics, soil fertility prescriptions, weather spraying schedules, and mandi price alerts.
landing.enterpriseHeroDesc: Aggregated yield predictions, regional disease spread telemetry, and supply chain pricing intelligence.
landing.benefit1Desc: Prevent prophylactic over-spraying with confirmed biological remedies and IPM practices.
landing.benefit2Title: Up to 25% Higher Realized Market Prices
landing.benefit2Desc: Time your mandi arrivals using 7 to 30-day neural price forecasts and MSP alerts.
landing.benefit3Desc: Automated rainfall and disease outbreak alerts synchronize directly with farm calendar tasks.
landing.benefit4Desc: Switch seamlessly between English, Marathi, and Hindi with regional agronomy terminology.
landing.faqQ1: What camera devices are supported for plant leaf disease scanning?
landing.faqA1: Any standard smartphone, tablet, or laptop camera works directly. Simply ensure good daylight and hold the camera 4 to 6 inches from the affected leaf.
landing.faqQ2: Can I use KrishiMitra in regional languages?
landing.faqA2: Yes! KrishiMitra features complete native support for English, Marathi (मराठी), and Hindi (हिंदी) across all pages, diagnostics, and AI assistance.
landing.faqQ3: How accurate is the AI diagnostic model?
landing.faqA3: Our convolutional vision models achieve 94.8% test accuracy across 38 crop pathology classes, with built-in safety guardrails that withhold chemical recommendations on low-confidence captures.
landing.faqQ4: Are government market prices updated daily?
landing.faqA4: Yes. APMC mandi auction modal rates are synchronized in real-time from official agricultural market data feeds across Maharashtra and major Indian mandis.
landing.faqQ5: Is my farm data safe and private?
landing.faqA5: Yes. Farm boundaries, diagnostic logs, and financial records are securely encrypted and never shared with third parties without your consent.
